# packagerepo

```go
import "github.com/blanketops/environments/pkg/secrets/git/packagerepo"
```

Package packagerepo reconciles the Package repository clone secret — the same ExternalSecret lifecycle as the state\-repository variant \(pkg/secrets/git/staterepo\), scoped to a Package's declared package repository.

The package repository is fetched by kapp\-controller, so the Secret carries the keys kapp\-controller reads for git over SSH: ssh\-privatekey and ssh\-knownhosts.

<a name="PackageRepositorySecretReconciler"></a>
## type PackageRepositorySecretReconciler

PackageRepositorySecretReconciler converges the ExternalSecret used to clone a Package's declared package repository — the same lifecycle as PackageStateRepositorySecretReconciler, for the repository kapp\-controller fetches.
